diagnostics.label: frozen VolGAN validation diagnostics; not hedge performance or independent test paths

definitions.energy_score: Euclidean empirical joint energy score; lower is better, raw log-return units
definitions.interval_score_90: width + 20 times distance outside the central 90% interval; lower is better
definitions.conditional_covariance: average within-state sample covariance, not unconditional realized covariance
definitions.mixture_covariance: within-state population covariance plus population covariance of conditional means
definitions.surface_changes: per-asset grid-average log-IV changes; correlations computed within each state
